name: com.stitchpunk.dotsanimationtoolkit
description: DOTS-native animation toolkit for Unity Entities: 2.5D cutout transform tracks, flipbook sprite animation, and bone/vertex animation textures (VAT), with blob-baked clip registries, Burst-compiled sampling, and an editor clip pipeline. Pre-release: version 0.1.0 contains the package skeleton only (build step C0); feature modules land in subsequent 0.x versions.
